verdict.rationale: Xero has a documented developer API with official OpenAPI (Swagger) specifications and an official SDK described as accessing "general ledger accounting data," and its MCP server exposes Chart of Accounts management. However, nothing in the evidence shows a trial balance report, a full general-ledger or journals export endpoint, or the data formats returned. Missing for 10: an evidenced trial balance endpoint, an evidenced full GL/journal-line export, documentation of export formats (JSON/CSV), and independent hands-on corroboration.
